tiebreakers.description: Tied player who played first in the last round wins

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Building and Specialist PP values are printed on tiles, so they are scorer inputs. Rulebook wording says the player who 'played first on last round' wins ties. Game ends when a player places last Standard Building, a boat colour runs out, or Specialist/Building row cannot be replenished (finish round).
